description: This PHP file contains utility functions related to the TestLink XML-RPC API, such as displaying sample messages and executing test calls with debugging output.

methods.name: show_api_db_sample_msg
methods.description: Outputs a sample message indicating the script can be run against a sample database.

methods.name: runTest
methods.description: Performs a test call to the XML-RPC client, outputs debug information if enabled, and returns the response.
